scope: Static read-only review. No operational scripts executed, no production/memory mutation, no provider/network calls. Report only in W.
verified_by_reading: Restart targets only the exact web child identified by supervisor and original 8082 listener; no llama or bench stop/restart commands.
Restart writes STOP_REQUESTED before stopping and refuses blind repetition after a receipt exists.
verify_live checks installed file hashes, source/control binding, Haiku prefix, account-file equality and operator restriction, resident bench snapshot, and HTTP status.
final_checks pins controller/regression/integration/provider receipts and exact staged bytes; independent plan hash is required.

record_delivery uses byte backups, verifies preappend bytes, preserves original bytes as prefix, retains line-ending convention and requires growth. Seven named surfaces come from the existing local inventory.
nonblocking_notes: record_delivery is intentionally not automatically resumable: after a partial append, rerun stops at an existing marker. Reconcile completed surfaces and their immediate backups manually before continuing; do not remove markers or repeat appends blindly.
final_checks and verify_live reports are evidence gates, not permission to deploy or proof of physical-device/end-user generation testing.
Operational script pins must be regenerated in final_checks after any accepted correction.

resolved_findings.title: PASS does not bind the healthy listener to the new web process
resolved_findings.detail: The initial listener owner is verified before Stop-Process. After restart, the code only finds a child with matching parent/path and accepts any 200 from 127.0.0.1:8082/login. If another process acquires 8082 while the new child is still initializing (or failing to bind), this records PASS and new_web_pid without proving that process serves the response.
resolved_findings.minimal_change: Before recording PASS, reread the 8082 Listen owner and require it equals taskNew[0].ProcessId; retain the existing supervisor/path checks. Prefer a second PID/owner check after the HTTP probe.
resolved_findings.resolution: After HTTP response the script rereads the listener owner and requires the new PID, then revalidates its supervisor parent and exact script path before PASS.
resolved_findings.verified_by: Static control-flow review and PowerShell AST parse; no restart executed.
